infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Trade Report uses your camera to take before and after job photos and to measure distances with AR for your reports.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Trade Report needs access to your photo library so you can add existing photos to a job report.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Trade Report uses the microphone so you can dictate job notes. Audio is transcribed on this device and is not uploaded.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Trade Report uses your location to stamp the job address on photos when you turn on the evidence location stamp.
